summary.headline: Front-week is controlled/range-oriented while Friday carries the strongest long-convexity and downside-protection inventory
key_points: 7750 is the common weekly pivot, but its function changes by expiry.
Tuesday is mixed/capped; Wednesday has the cleanest 7750-7800 range structure.
Thursday is supportive near spot but raw premium is dominated by 7530/7550 complex call vertical inventory.
Friday is the principal risk bucket: 7740-7660 downside protection coexists with strong 7775 upside call demand.
Baseline risk is back-loaded to Friday, but no cross-expiry roll is claimed until a later snapshot confirms migration.
summary.daily_note: Baseline t0: controlled Tue/Wed, low-information complex Thu, convex Friday. Watch whether Friday downside protection migrates closer to spot and whether 7775 changes from conflict into accepted upside demand.

leave_one_out.comment: The largest print is a Thursday 7530C spread leg. Removing it makes raw weekly call selling more negative but does not alter the weekly regime; Thursday directional interpretation is based on near-spot flow after separating the 7530/7550 complex inventory.

levels.label: WEEKLY 7750 MAIN PIVOT
levels.interpretation: 7750 repeats across every expiry but changes function by date: Tuesday/Wednesday friction, Thursday conditional floor, Friday central call supply. It is the weekly state anchor.

notes: Cross-expiry role is more informative than the raw aggregate sign.

levels.label: WEEKLY 7775 UPPER DECISION
levels.interpretation: 7775 carries bearish inventory in Tuesday but strong upside convexity in Friday. Acceptance above it is therefore the key cross-expiry regime-change test.

notes: The sign of fresh flow at 7775 is a priority stateful update variable.

levels.label: WEEKLY 7740 LOWER DECISION
levels.interpretation: 7740 is the first weekly level where Friday downside protection becomes active while Tuesday still has competing bullish spread inventory.

notes: Watch whether later snapshots move protection from 7675/7660 closer to 7740/7725.

levels.label: WEEKLY 7660-7675 PROTECTION CLUSTER
levels.interpretation: The deepest clean weekly protection is back-loaded into Friday, especially the 7675/7660 block put cluster.

notes: Migration of this protection closer to spot would be a material deterioration signal.

monetization_zones.description: The baseline weekly control band is 7740-7775. Inside it, front-week structures favor chop/decay more than directional realization.
monetization_zones.caveat: Friday already owns convexity on both sides, so boundary acceptance can change the regime quickly.

summary.headline: Mixed/capped Tuesday with 7740-7750 as the tactical pivot and 7775 as the upper decision level
key_points: Near-spot calls are net sold while near-spot puts are net bought.
7740/7750 bullish call-spread-like flow conflicts with 7775 synthetic-short-like inventory.
Acceptance above 7760-7775 would invalidate the capped baseline; acceptance below 7740 shifts focus to 7730 then 7710/7700.

leave_one_out.comment: Removing the largest Tuesday print does not change the sign of the raw call-flow imbalance.

levels.label: TUE ACTIVE PIVOT
levels.interpretation: Late call buying is concentrated at 7745; this is the most active local pivot inside the 7740-7750 battle zone.

levels.label: TUE 7750 FRICTION
levels.interpretation: Call selling dominates at 7750 while puts are also net sold; this is central friction rather than a clean directional support.

levels.label: TUE 7760 CALL SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: Net call selling at 7760 makes this the first upside absorption test.

levels.label: TUE 7775 UPPER DECISION
levels.interpretation: 7775 combines call sale with substantial put buying, including a synthetic-short-like package.

levels.label: TUE 7730 FIRST PROTECTION
levels.interpretation: Bought puts at 7730 are the first clean downside protection pocket below the main pivot.

levels.label: TUE 7700 CONDITIONAL LOWER ZONE
levels.interpretation: Put selling dominates at 7700, so the level acts as conditional risk acceptance rather than guaranteed support.

structures.interpretation: Same-time, same-size call sale plus put purchase is synthetic-short-like; it makes 7775 an upper decision level but does not prove opening bearish inventory.
Same-time, same-size 7740C buy / 7750C sell is call-debit-spread-like and offsets part of the upper bearish inventory.

monetization_zones.description: The baseline favors chop/decay while spot remains inside the central 7740-7760 inventory cluster.
monetization_zones.caveat: The 7775 synthetic-short-like package is unconfirmed as opening inventory.

summary.headline: Wednesday is the cleanest range architecture: 7750-7800 body with 7725/7825 wings
key_points: A same-time 198-lot four-leg package is short-condor-like.
Separate 7800 call+put buying makes 7800 a volatility trigger, not just a cap.
Inside 7750-7800 the baseline is range/decay; outside 7725 or 7825 the structure moves into realization.

leave_one_out.comment: Removing the 7800P block substantially reduces but does not reverse Wednesday net put buying.

levels.label: WED LOWER RANGE BODY
levels.interpretation: 7750 is the lower short-premium body of the condor-like structure and carries additional call supply.

levels.label: WED 7800 VOL / UPPER DECISION
levels.interpretation: 7800 is simultaneously the upper short-premium body and a bought-straddle-like volatility center.

levels.label: WED 7725 LOWER WING
levels.interpretation: 7725 is the downside wing of the condor-like structure and the first clean breakdown route.

levels.label: WED 7825 UPPER WING
levels.interpretation: 7825 is the upper long wing of the condor-like structure and the first route after accepted trade above 7800.

levels.label: WED 7775 PUT DEMAND
levels.interpretation: Net put buying at 7775 adds defensive flow inside the nominal 7750-7800 body.

structures.interpretation: Four same-time, same-size legs define a short-condor-like 7750-7800 body with 7725/7825 wings. The linkage is highly probable even without a complex-order ID.
Same-time, same-size call and put buying makes 7800 a bought-volatility center rather than a simple resistance strike.

monetization_zones.description: The 7750-7800 body is the clearest baseline range-monetization zone of the week.
monetization_zones.caveat: Opening/closing is unknown, and the 7800 long-straddle-like flow creates conflict at the upper body.

summary.headline: Thursday is supportive near spot but heavily contaminated by 7530/7550 complex call inventory
key_points: Only a small fraction of Thursday gross premium is near spot.
7750 sold-put risk acceptance is the cleanest active near-spot feature.
The 7530/7550 vertical inventory must be excluded from directional interpretation; its largest print can even flip raw Thursday call net.

leave_one_out.comment: Removing the largest 7530C buy flips raw Thursday call net from positive to negative, confirming that gross/raw call direction is unstable and dominated by complex ITM inventory.

levels.label: THU 7750 CONDITIONAL FLOOR
levels.interpretation: Near spot, 7750 is dominated by sold puts and is the cleanest supportive feature of Thursday.

levels.label: THU 7720 PROTECTION WING
levels.interpretation: Bought puts at 7720 repeatedly pair with 7750 sold puts, making this the first downside wing if the conditional floor fails.

levels.label: THU 7530 COMPLEX INVENTORY
levels.interpretation: Huge gross call activity is part of repeated 7530/7550 vertical-like inventory and should not be interpreted directionally.

levels.label: THU 7550 COMPLEX INVENTORY
levels.interpretation: Huge two-way call activity is paired with 7530 and is treated as complex inventory rather than current directional conviction.

structures.interpretation: Approximately 86% of Thursday gross premium sits in repeated 7530/7550 call vertical-like churn in both directions. Treat as complex inventory/adjustment, not as a clean directional signal.
Repeated same-size 7720P buy / 7750P sell packages are put-credit-spread-like, reinforcing 7750 as a conditional floor while defining 7720 as the protection wing.

monetization_zones.description: Holding above 7750 is the monetization path for the clean near-spot supportive Thursday structure.
monetization_zones.caveat: Below 7750 the supportive interpretation weakens; below 7720 the spread wing is breached.

summary.headline: Friday is the principal weekly convexity bucket: defensive put ladder below 7740 plus upside demand at 7775
key_points: The 8020/8025 deep-ITM put pair is a vertical-like package and does not explain away the broader put demand.
Downside protection is distributed across 7740, 7700, 7675 and 7660, with the strongest block concentration at 7675.
7775 calls are materially net bought, so Friday is better described as long-convexity with defensive skew than as a simple bearish book.

leave_one_out.comment: Removing the $2.6m 8025P leg reduces net put buying but leaves Friday puts materially net bought; the defensive reading survives.

levels.label: FRI 7750 CENTRAL FRICTION
levels.interpretation: Heavy net call selling at 7750 makes it central friction between downside protection below and upside demand above.

levels.label: FRI 7775 UPSIDE CONVEXITY
levels.interpretation: Strong net call buying plus additional put demand make 7775 a two-sided volatility/decision level with clear upside convexity.

levels.label: FRI 7740 FIRST ACTIVE PROTECTION
levels.interpretation: Net put buying at 7740 is the first active downside protection zone directly below the central band.

levels.label: FRI 7700 SECONDARY DOWNSIDE ROUTE
levels.interpretation: Bought puts remain positive at 7700 and provide the intermediate route between 7740 and the deeper protection cluster.

levels.label: FRI 7675 MAJOR PROTECTION
levels.interpretation: Large block put buying is concentrated at 7675 and is the strongest lower downside-protection strike.

levels.label: FRI 7660 LOWER PROTECTION
levels.interpretation: Additional same-time block put buying extends the Friday protection ladder to 7660.

levels.label: FRI 7800 UPSIDE CONTINUATION
levels.interpretation: Net call buying is positive at 7800; accepted trade above 7775 can route into 7800 before 7825.

structures.interpretation: The two largest Friday put prints are a same-time 5-point deep-ITM vertical-like package. Their gross premium should not be mistaken for standalone downside conviction.
Large same-time block put buying at 7675 and 7660 is a clear downside-protection cluster, though it may be hedge inventory rather than a directional short.
Session-aggregated 7775 calls show materially more bought than sold premium, making 7775 the clearest upside convexity trigger in the Friday book.

monetization_zones.description: Accepted trade below 7740 increasingly activates the Friday protection ladder toward 7700 and 7675/7660.
monetization_zones.caveat: Protection demand is not proof of directional short exposure; opening/closing is unknown.

monetization_zones.description: Acceptance above 7775 activates the upside convexity route through 7800 toward 7825.
monetization_zones.caveat: 7750 call supply and mixed complex flow can still cap failed breakouts.

scenarios.name: Controlled front-week / range

triggers.description: Keep Friday downside protection from activating near spot
No new broad front-week volatility bid

invalidations: Accepted trade below 7740 with fresh put buying
scenarios.interpretation: While spot remains inside 7740-7775, the baseline favors chop/decay and expiry-specific mean reversion rather than a clean weekly directional trend.

scenarios.name: Upside realization

triggers.description: Absorb Tuesday upper bearish inventory and activate Friday call demand
Fresh calls buy rather than sell at the weekly decision level

scenarios.interpretation: Acceptance above 7775 turns the cross-expiry conflict into upside realization, first through 7800 and then 7825.

scenarios.name: Downside protection activation

triggers.description: Move below the first active Friday protection strike
Protection migrates closer to spot / expands across nearby strikes
Downside volatility bid confirms protection activation

invalidations: Friday protection is monetized or removed in the next snapshot
scenarios.interpretation: Below 7740, the existing Friday protection ladder becomes increasingly relevant. Migration of protection from 7675/7660 toward 7725/7740 would materially strengthen this scenario.

caveats: 1047 of 1250 rows are flagged Spread, but complex_order_id is absent, so package linkage is inferred from timestamp/size/strike logic.
Thursday gross premium is dominated by deep-ITM 7530/7550 call vertical-like inventory and is not read directionally.
Large ITM premium can reflect intrinsic value rather than conviction.
Visible tape is not the full market position.
The source timestamp field is carried by the export with America/New_York metadata, while this report snapshot is explicitly timestamped in Cyprus time.
